strongest_counterhypothesis: A normal branch->ActionSemanticKey projection and cardinality check, embedded in the existing loop controller, reproduces IAC without a new runtime structure; wider compute allocation remains better handled by rational/nonmyopic metareasoning.
evidence: Plain action-set-cardinality predicate was equivalent to IAC on every reachable prefix in all tested seeds/regimes.
Action-preserving POMDP simplification and value-directed belief methods are established prior art.
IAC still exposes useful safety lesions: stale mapping and incomplete branch coverage must fail closed.
Local simulator shows action-invariance can save substantial recurrence relative to state certainty without accepting the rare-branch error of a 0.90 confidence threshold.
